name: Santhosh
headline: Agentic AI for security operations and data protection.
bio: I build AI systems that help security teams investigate, protect data, and manage cryptographic assets. My work connects intent routing, retrieval, specialist agents, and operational tools.

projects.label: Security operations
projects.title: Role-aware agents for security operations
projects.summary: Natural-language intent routing into log and case retrieval, role-specific analysis, playbooks, and operational tools across SIEM, SOAR, IAM, application security, OT, and firewall workflows.

projects.label: Data protection
projects.title: From sensitive-data discovery to reviewed protection
projects.summary: Browser-guided discovery links sensitive fields to application evidence. Reviewed, role-specific policy plans lead to approved Casbin enforcement on an instrumented application, followed by runtime validation.

projects.label: Certificates + crypto
projects.title: Certificate lifecycle and cryptographic posture
projects.summary: Certificate discovery, requests, approvals, issuance, renewal, and revocation, alongside cryptographic inventories, shared-asset correlation, and rule-based post-quantum readiness assessment.

notes: MCP tools that produce Word reports and Excel workbooks.
Retrieval pipelines that connect regulatory questions to source evidence.
Agent-memory experiments across short-term, entity, and long-term context.
